title: 第344章 我有意见
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“够了！你们一个个的，故意给我们赵家添堵是吧？”赵秉谦脸色铁青地怒视着众人。

“这一个个的，要查到什么时候去？”

“呵，赵秉谦道友此话就不对了，你赵家的命就是命，难道我们这些家族的命就不是命了？”裴云虎冷笑道。

“对！”

其他家族筑基强者闻言，纷纷附和。

见到此景，赵秉谦心中恼怒不已，不过眼见各大家族联起手来，他也不敢做得太过了。

于是就想了一个折中的办法，要一起查也可以，但是只查散修，碧空岛的各大家族之人，都不在盘查之列。

说是这样，有利于碧空岛团结。

各大家族见赵秉谦让步，也并未多死缠烂打，纷纷表示同意。

死道友不死贫道，只要不查自己的储物空间，那些散修就不关他们的事了。

而且各大家族谁也不敢保证，自家的练气期弟子，有没有对其他家族下死手。

万一真查出点什么，难道他们还真要相互拼命不成？

而经赵秉谦这么一说，局面立刻就变了。

各大家族从对立面，站到了一条阵线上，剩下的散修，几乎没有任何话语权。

散修虽然多，但筑基期的也就二三十人而已，而且绝大多数都只是筑基初期境界，根本无法跟这些家族抗衡。

“韩兄，你要不要到我们柳家这边来，说不定能蒙混过去。”柳三春的声音，忽然在韩林脑中响起。

“多谢柳道友相邀，不过不用了，我有办法应付。”韩林闻言朝柳家方向看了眼，感激地回道。

“好，那你保重。”

听韩林这么说，柳三春也就不多言了。

韩林也不再看柳家方向，不动声色地将自己的储物戒和随身物品全部收进了通天宝库之中。

只留下一个储物袋挂在腰上，用来掩人耳目。

有仙眼空间在，他相信赵家就算将他全身搜个遍，也不可能搜出什么东西来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"That's enough! One by one, you are deliberately causing trouble for our Zhao family, right?" Zhao Bingqian glared at everyone with a livid face.

"When are you going to check each one of them?"

"Haha, what Fellow Taoist Zhao Bingqian said is wrong. The life of your Zhao family is life. Could it be that the life of our family is not life?" Pei Yunhu sneered.

"Yes!"

Hearing this, the other family's foundation-building experts all agreed.

Seeing this scene, Zhao Bingqian was very angry, but seeing the major families joining forces, he did not dare to go too far.

So I thought of a compromise. It was okay to check them all together, but only the casual cultivators were checked, and the members of the major families on Bikong Island were not included in the investigation.

Saying this is conducive to the unity of Blue Sky Island.

When the major families saw Zhao Bingqian's concession, they agreed without any more persistence.

Dead Taoist friends are not poor Taoists. As long as they don't check their own storage space, those casual cultivators have nothing to do with them.

Moreover, no one from the major families can guarantee whether their own Qi-training disciples will kill other families.

If something is really found out, will they really have to fight each other?

But after Zhao Bingqian said this, the situation immediately changed.

The major families stood on the same front from opposite sides, and the remaining casual cultivators had almost no right to speak.

Although there are many casual cultivators, there are only twenty or thirty people in the foundation building stage, and most of them are only in the early stage of foundation building and cannot compete with these families.

"Brother Han, why don't you come to our Liu family, maybe you can get away with it." Liu Sanchun's voice suddenly sounded in Han Lin's mind.

"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Liu, for inviting me, but no, I have a way to deal with it." Hearing this, Han Lin glanced in the direction of the Liu family and replied gratefully.

"Okay, then take care of yourself."

After hearing what Han Lin said, Liu Sanchun didn't say much.

Han Lin stopped looking in the direction of the Liu family and quietly put all his storage rings and belongings into the Tongtian Treasure House.

Only a storage bag was left hanging on the waist to hide from others.

With the Immortal Eye Dimension present, he believed that even if the Zhao family searched him all over, they wouldn't be able to find anything.
